f3_program: collection("natalia.cycling_distances", "distance", "natalia", source("Natalia is riding a bicycle for the cycling competition. On Monday she rode 40 kilometers and on Tuesday 50 kilometers"))
member("natalia.cycling_distances", "natalia.cycling_distances.monday", source("On Monday she rode 40 kilometers"))
member("natalia.cycling_distances", "natalia.cycling_distances.tuesday", source("on Tuesday 50 kilometers"))
member("natalia.cycling_distances", "natalia.cycling_distances.wednesday", source("On Wednesday she rode 50% fewer kilometers than the day before"))
member("natalia.cycling_distances", "natalia.cycling_distances.thursday", source("On Thursday she rode as many as the sum of the kilometers from Monday and Wednesday"))
observe(at("natalia.cycling_distances.monday", "monday"), 40, "kilometer", source("On Monday she rode 40 kilometers"))
observe(at("natalia.cycling_distances.tuesday", "tuesday"), 50, "kilometer", source("on Tuesday 50 kilometers"))
percent_less(at("natalia.cycling_distances.wednesday", "wednesday"), at("natalia.cycling_distances.tuesday", "tuesday"), 50, source("On Wednesday she rode 50% fewer kilometers than the day before"))

sum_relation(at("natalia.cycling_distances.thursday", "thursday"), at("natalia.cycling_distances.monday", "monday"), at("natalia.cycling_distances.wednesday", "wednesday"), source("On Thursday she rode as many as the sum of the kilometers from Monday and Wednesday"))
query("sum", "natalia.cycling_distances", "monday_through_thursday")
assumptions: Natalie in the question refers to Natalia.

f3_program: observe(at("june.school_supply_funds.amount", "initial"), 500, "dollar", source("June has $500 for buying school supplies for the new school year"))

collection("june.purchased_books", "book", "june", source("She buys four maths books at $20 each, six more science books than maths books at $10 each, and twice as many art books as maths books at $20 each"))
member("june.purchased_books", "june.purchased_books.maths", source("four maths books at $20 each"))
member("june.purchased_books", "june.purchased_books.science", source("six more science books than maths books at $10 each"))
member("june.purchased_books", "june.purchased_books.art", source("twice as many art books as maths books at $20 each"))
member("june.purchased_books", "june.purchased_books.music", source("she also bought music books"))
observe(at("june.purchased_books.maths.count", "purchased"), 4, "count", source("four maths books"))
observe(at("june.purchased_books.maths.unit_price", "purchase"), 20, "dollar_per_book", source("four maths books at $20 each"))
offset(at("june.purchased_books.science.count", "purchased"), at("june.purchased_books.maths.count", "purchased"), 6, "count", source("six more science books than maths books"))
observe(at("june.purchased_books.science.unit_price", "purchase"), 10, "dollar_per_book", source("six more science books than maths books at $10 each"))
multiple(at("june.purchased_books.art.count", "purchased"), at("june.purchased_books.maths.count", "purchased"), 2, source("twice as many art books as maths books"))
observe(at("june.purchased_books.art.unit_price", "purchase"), 20, "dollar_per_book", source("twice as many art books as maths books at $20 each"))

product_relation("june.purchased_books.maths.spending", at("june.purchased_books.maths.count", "purchased"), at("june.purchased_books.maths.unit_price", "purchase"), source("four maths books at $20 each"))

product_relation("june.purchased_books.science.spending", at("june.purchased_books.science.count", "purchased"), at("june.purchased_books.science.unit_price", "purchase"), source("six more science books than maths books at $10 each"))

product_relation("june.purchased_books.art.spending", at("june.purchased_books.art.count", "purchased"), at("june.purchased_books.art.unit_price", "purchase"), source("twice as many art books as maths books at $20 each"))
remove("buy_maths_books", "june", at("june.school_supply_funds.amount", "current"), "june.purchased_books.maths.spending", source("She buys four maths books at $20 each"))

remove("buy_science_books", "june", at("june.school_supply_funds.amount", "current"), "june.purchased_books.science.spending", source("She buys four maths books at $20 each, six more science books than maths books at $10 each"))
remove("buy_art_books", "june", at("june.school_supply_funds.amount", "current"), "june.purchased_books.art.spending", source("and twice as many art books as maths books at $20 each"))
remove("buy_music_books", "june", at("june.school_supply_funds.amount", "current"), "june.purchased_books.music.spending", source("she also bought music books"))
query("value", event_field("buy_music_books", "quantity"))
assumptions: The $500 is an available school-supply fund; the source does not state that June exhausts it or has no money remaining, so the music-book spending is not uniquely determined.

f3_program: collection("garden.bugs", "bug", "garden", source("the garden has 400 bugs to start"))
observe(at("garden.bugs.count", "initial"), 400, "count", source("the garden has 400 bugs to start"))
same(at("garden.bugs.count", "before_spray"), at("garden.bugs.count", "initial"), source("the garden has 400 bugs to start, and Bill sprays once"))

percent_of(at("garden.bugs.count", "after_spray"), at("garden.bugs.count", "before_spray"), 80, source("each time he sprays the garden he reduces the total bug population to 80% of what it was previously"))

difference_relation("spray_once.bugs_removed.count", at("garden.bugs.count", "before_spray"), at("garden.bugs.count", "after_spray"), source("reduces the total bug population to 80% of what it was previously"))
remove("spray_once", "bill", at("garden.bugs.count", "current"), "spray_once.bugs_removed.count", source("Bill sprays once"))
collection("garden.spiders", "spider", "garden", source("introduces 12 spiders"))
add("introduce_spiders", "bill", at("garden.spiders.count", "current"), 12, source("introduces 12 spiders"))
consume("introduced_spiders_eat_bugs", "garden.spiders", at("garden.bugs.count", "current"), scale(event_field("introduce_spiders", "quantity"), 7), source("Each spider he introduces eats 7 bugs"))
query("remaining_count", "garden.bugs", "current")
assumptions: The single spray occurs before the introduced spiders eat bugs, following the sentence order.

f3_program: collection("henry.lollipops", "lollipop", "henry", source("Henry has 30 more lollipops than Alison does"))
collection("alison.lollipops", "lollipop", "alison", source("Henry has 30 more lollipops than Alison does"))
collection("diane.lollipops", "lollipop", "diane", source("Alisson has half the number of lollipops Diane has"))
collection("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops", "lollipop", "henry_alison_diane", source("they combine the lollipops"))
observe(at("alison.lollipops.count", "initial"), 60, "count", source("With 60 lollipops"))
offset(at("henry.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("alison.lollipops.count", "initial"), 30, "count", source("Henry has 30 more lollipops than Alison does"))
fraction_of(at("alison.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("diane.lollipops.count", "initial"), 1, 2, source("Alisson has half the number of lollipops Diane has"))

sum_relation(at("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.count", "initial"), at("henry.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("alison.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("diane.lollipops.count", "initial"), source("they combine the lollipops"))
observe(at("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.consumption_rate", "daily"), 45, "lollipop_per_day", source("eat 45 lollipops each day"))
consume("daily_eating", "henry_alison_diane", at("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.count", "current"), 45, source("eat 45 lollipops each day"))

rate_relation(at("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.count", "initial"), at("henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.consumption_rate", "daily"), "henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.finish_duration_days", source("eat 45 lollipops each day"))
query("value", "henry_alison_diane.combined_lollipops.finish_duration_days")
assumptions: Alison and Alisson refer to the same person.
They refers collectively to Henry, Alison, and Diane, and 45 lollipops per day is their combined consumption rate.

f3_program: collection("quinten.estimated_building_heights", "height", "downtown", source("Quinten sees three buildings downtown and decides to estimate their heights"))
member("quinten.estimated_building_heights", "quinten.estimated_building_heights.left", source("The one on the left looks like it is 80% of the height of the middle one"))
member("quinten.estimated_building_heights", "quinten.estimated_building_heights.middle", source("the one in the middle is 100 feet tall"))

member("quinten.estimated_building_heights", "quinten.estimated_building_heights.right", source("The one on the right looks 20 feet shorter than if the building on the left and middle were stacked on top of each other"))
observe(at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.middle", "estimated"), 100, "foot", source("the one in the middle is 100 feet tall"))

percent_of(at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.left", "estimated"), at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.middle", "estimated"), 80, source("The one on the left looks like it is 80% of the height of the middle one"))

sum_relation(at("quinten.left_middle_stacked_height", "hypothetical"), at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.left", "estimated"), at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.middle", "estimated"), source("if the building on the left and middle were stacked on top of each other"))

offset(at("quinten.estimated_building_heights.right", "estimated"), at("quinten.left_middle_stacked_height", "hypothetical"), -20, "foot", source("20 feet shorter than if the building on the left and middle were stacked on top of each other"))
query("sum", "quinten.estimated_building_heights", "estimated")
